subject: Salem Place Mixed-Use Development Proposal
overview: The development team presented initial designs for a proposed nine-unit mixed-use building at 290 Salem Street and answered questions from area residents.

items.title: Development Proposal Presentation
items.summary: Attorney Adam Barnosky and architect Jacob Levine presented plans for a three-story mixed-use project at 290 Salem Street featuring nine residential units, ground-floor commercial space, and rear parking.

items.title: Public Comment and Neighborhood Feedback
items.summary: Residents and city officials raised concerns and asked questions regarding street parking shortages, public meeting notices, zoning relief, inclusionary housing options, and architectural alignment with nearby historic buildings.
